title: Goal: characterize neuron-functional-type x layer x firing-rate x waveform x LFP/phase-locking relationships during omission, for a major supplemental figure
notes: Hamm's request (2026-08-15): for each functional class (S+/S++/S-/S--/O+/O++/O-/O--), determine what can be strongly said about cortical layer (vFLIP), firing rate, waveform, and other important features; search for any statistically significant, reliable, physically plausible relationship among ~10 areas x 4 layers x firing rate x LFP band power x phase locking/oscillatory relationships during omission; list them all; track here.
